There's an effective strategy I used for coming off nicotine. To break it down:

  1. Get a vape pen with a decent sized tank on it.
  2. Fill it with e-liquid containing nicotine.
  3. As you consume the nicotine in the e-liquid, the e-liquid level will drop.
  4. As the e-liquid level drops, refill it with e-liquid containing no nicotine.
  5. You will eventually wind up with no nicotine in the vape.

In this way, you gradually wean yourself off nicotine. They use weaning in hospitals to make sure patients don't become morphine addicts, and while not a precise as their methods, it is the same principle and I found it does work.

Some people may point out that vaping can be harmful. You can perform this strategy with cigarettes as well, by modifying the cigarettes. Measure the length of the cigarette, and cut 1/4 off the top. Then, take a second and make a slightly smaller cut. Continue doing this until you have just a small stub of a cigarette. Smoke these, as your cravings dictate, and it will help with the withdrawal.

It takes about three days to get out of the worst of it. It's a hell of an addictive substance. Good luck.
